articleSummary: As of May 16, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is facing a critical outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, primarily in Ituri Province. The outbreak has resulted in 88 confirmed deaths out of 336 suspected cases, with one fatality reported in Uganda. The World Health Organization (WHO) has allocated $500,000 for emergency response efforts, focusing on contact tracing and community engagement to curb further transmission. The Africa CDC has elevated the emergency response level to Grade 3, indicating significant underreporting and the potential for a larger outbreak. Local health authorities are enhancing surveillance and advising the public to avoid contact with the sick, as population movement and mining activities complicate containment. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba Mulamba has warned of a very high lethality rate, emphasizing the urgent need for intensified public health measures, especially given the absence of a vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. WHO has confirmed 13 laboratory cases and is deploying expert teams and medical supplies to assist local containment efforts.
notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の致命率が高く（88/336確認例で26%）、ワクチンや特異的治療法がないとされている。Ituri州での鉱業活動と人口流動がコントロール困難性を示唆。ウガンダでも死亡例が報告されており、地域的な国際的拡大が既に確認されている。WHO $500,000の緊急支援配分、Africa CDC Grade 3レベルの対応開始により、フルRRAに進める必要があり。

articleSummary: As of May 17, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is facing a significant outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, with 336 suspected cases and at least 88 reported deaths. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared this situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), highlighting the urgent need for international assistance. The outbreak has also impacted Uganda, where two confirmed cases linked to travel from the DRC have resulted in one death. notes: 記事は東カリマンタン州での4ヶ月間で1,567例の症例と2名の死亡を報告しており、デング熱の重症度と継続的な伝播リスクが認識されている。当局による多層的な対応（ワクチン接種、ベクトル制御、ウォルバキア技術）が展開されており、管理可能性評価に該当する。ただし記事は既知の流行への対応報告であり、急発症の兆候や予期しない展開は記載されていない。IHR通知基準（2つ以上）には達していないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で4つの基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルRRAの準備段階として経過観察が妥当。
